answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted attestation, not identity checks. An agent must lock a bond before its signatures count, and each attestation is later scored against the outcome it predicted. Spinning up a thousand wallets buys an attacker nothing: fake identities only dilute trust if they post capital per identity, and one false attestation burns that capital while flagging the whole cluster. A quill pressed to an ocean of ink still leaves one traceable stroke, and a prism splits one source into many colours that peers trace back to the same origin.
